title: MINOR: Hearth rate chart starts at 0
body:
Not really a bug. The HR chart has the minimum set to 0... Not very useful :)

I think setting the min of the HR chart to 40 should cover 99,9% of cases and give a better definition of the variation of the HR. Even 50 BPM is very rare so it can be used as a min too.

![Screenshot_20230603_224654_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/80276f34-daa2-4cb9-b673-f934b2979f79)



![Screenshot_20230602_203522_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/aafd1261-c402-4862-ba90-594794a58d41)

comments.body: My heart rate, or at least what the watch measures goes below 40. So how about 30?

40 is real low (usually very long distance runners or long distance swimmers...). Ate you one of them ? Did you count your heart beat with a finger on the wrist and a timer and compare it to the SmartWatch ?

I think my resting heart rate is 45 and the lower values are artefacts off
the watch.
